items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on the project: a landing page usually takes one to two weeks, a visual identity two to four, and a full website three to six. We agree on a clear timeline with milestones before we start.

We set the budget after the discovery session, based on the size of the project and the services you need. You get a detailed quote in Algerian dinars before any commitment, and payment is split into milestones.

items.q: What do I need to get started?
items.a: Knowing your goal and your audience is enough. If you have material (logo, photos, copy), send it over; if not, we help you prepare it during discovery.

items.q: Can I order just one service?
items.a: Yes. You can order a single service, such as a landing page or a logo, and add others later. We make sure everything we design stays consistent with your identity.
We hand over every file and admin access, and stay with you for a period after launch to fix anything that comes up. Monthly maintenance or ongoing content management can also be arranged.

faq.q: How much does a website cost?
faq.a: It depends on the number of pages and features (shop, booking, several languages). After the discovery session you get a detailed quote in Algerian dinars, with no commitment.

faq.q: How long does it take?
faq.a: A business website usually takes three to six weeks, depending on the amount of content and how quickly reviews come back. We agree on a timeline with milestones first.

faq.q: Can I edit the content myself after launch?
faq.a: Yes. We set up an easy way to change text and images, and hand you a short guide to running the site.

faq.q: Do you handle the domain and hosting?
faq.a: We help you choose the right domain and hosting and connect them; both stay in your name.

faq.q: What’s the difference between a landing page and a website?
faq.a: A website presents you in full; a landing page focuses on one offer and one goal, which is why it suits campaigns and ads.

faq.q: Do you write the copy too?
faq.a: Yes, we shape the message and the copy with you; it’s half of what makes the page work.

faq.q: Can it work with my ads?
faq.a: Yes, we prepare it for ad traffic and connect analytics so you can follow the results.

faq.q: How long does it take?
faq.a: Usually one to two weeks, depending on how ready the content is.

faq.q: How many logo proposals will I see?
faq.a: We present considered directions rather than dozens of random options, then develop the one you choose through review rounds.

faq.q: Do I own the logo?
faq.a: Yes, after handover all usage rights pass to you, along with the source files.

faq.q: Can you refresh my current logo instead of replacing it?
faq.a: Yes. Sometimes refreshing the logo and unifying how it’s used is enough.

faq.q: In which formats do I get the files?
faq.a: Files for print and screens (SVG, PDF, PNG) in colour and single-colour versions.

faq.q: Do I need technical knowledge?
faq.a: No. We build the system and explain it to your team in plain language.

faq.q: Which tools do you use?
faq.a: We choose based on your needs and budget: Google Sheets, forms, integration tools such as Make or n8n, and custom solutions when needed.

faq.q: What if my business changes later?
